subject: DI03000171

intro_text.en: Detailed sectional illustrations,fluid properties,pressure derivations and worked examples.
intro_text.gu: Detailed sectional diagrams,fluid properties,pressure derivations અને solved examples.

h.en: 1.1.1 What is a fluid? Models and types

body.en:
A fluid continuously deforms under an applied shear stress,however small,in the usual continuum description. Liquids have a free surface in an open container and are often treated as nearly incompressible;gases expand to fill the available volume and their density changes more strongly with pressure/temperature.

An ideal fluid is an analytical incompressible,inviscid model;real fluids possess viscosity. Newtonian fluids obey a linear shear-rate relation at a stated state;non-Newtonian fluids may show nonlinear,time-dependent or yield-stress behaviour. Compressible/incompressible refers to whether density variation matters in the particular analysis—not an absolute label for every flow.
body.gu:
Fluid applied shear stress હેઠળ continuously deform થાય. Liquid open vesselમાં free surface આપે અને ઘણી problemsમાં nearly incompressible;gas available volume ભરે અને density pressure/tempથી વધુ બદલાય.

Ideal fluid incompressible/inviscid model;real fluid viscous. Newtonian linear shear-rate law,non-Newtonian nonlinear/time/yield behaviour હોઈ શકે. Compressible/incompressible actual analysisમાં density change મહત્વનું છે કે નહિ તે દર્શાવે.

h.en: 1.1.2 Density,specific weight,specific volume and specific gravity

body.en:
Density rho=m/V,unit kg/m³. Specific weight gamma=W/V=rho g,unit N/m³. Specific volume v=V/m=1/rho,unit m³/kg. Specific gravity SG=rho/rho_ref is dimensionless;for liquids the reference is specified water,often approximated as1000kg/m³ in elementary problems.

Mass density is not weight density. Record temperature and reference where required;water density is not exactly1000 at every state. If g=9.81m/s² is used,the specific weight of the assumed1000kg/m³ water is9810N/m³,not1000N/m³.
body.gu:
rho=m/V kg/m³;gamma=W/V=rho g N/m³;v=V/m=1/rho m³/kg;SG=rho/rho_ref dimensionless. Liquid માટે specified water reference લો,elementary problemsમાં often1000kg/m³.

Mass density અને weight density અલગ. Temperature/reference જરૂરી;water દરેક stateમાં exactly1000 નથી. Given rho1000,g9.81 માટે gamma9810N/m³.

body.en:
Oil has mass17kg in20L. Convert20L=.020m³. rho=17/.020=850kg/m³;gamma=850×9.81=8338.5N/m³=8.3385kN/m³;v=1/850=.00117647m³/kg;SG=850/1000=.85 for the stated water reference.

Check dimensions first:using20 as cubic metres would reduce density by a factor1000. For equal masses,the less-dense fluid occupies a larger volume;for equal volumes,the denser fluid has larger mass.
body.gu:
Oil mass17kg,volume20L=.020m³. rho850kg/m³,gamma8338.5N/m³=8.3385kN/m³,v.00117647m³/kg,SG.85 given reference મુજબ.

20Lને20m³ ન ગણવું. Equal massમાં lower densityનું volume વધારે;equal volumeમાં higher densityનું mass વધારે.

body.en:
Bulk modulus K=−V(dp/dV);the minus sign makes K positive because volume falls as pressure rises. Volume compressibility beta=−(1/V)(dV/dp)=1/K. Units:K in Pa and beta in Pa⁻¹. A larger K means less compressibility.

For a small change with nearly constant K,Delta V≈−V Delta p/K. A liquid is often modelled incompressible but its finite compressibility matters in pressure waves and hydraulic systems. Gas bulk modulus depends on the compression path;do not use one liquid value for gases.
body.gu:
K=−V(dp/dV),pressure વધતાં volume ઘટે એટલે minus signથી positive. beta=−(1/V)(dV/dp)=1/K. K Pa,beta Pa⁻¹;larger K એટલે ઓછું compressible.

Small change માટે DeltaV≈−V Deltap/K. Liquids finite compressibility ધરાવે;pressure wavesમાં મહત્વનું. Gas K process path પર આધારિત.

body.en:
Assume liquid volume.050m³,constant K=2.2GPa and pressure rise4.4MPa. Use2.2×10⁹Pa and4.4×10⁶Pa:Delta V=−.050×4.4e6/2.2e9=−.000100m³=−.100L. Final volume=.049900m³.

Relative volume decrease=.002=.2%,not2%. The stated modulus is given illustrative data,not a universal value for every temperature or liquid.
body.gu:
V.050m³,K2.2GPa,pressure rise4.4MPa. DeltaV=−.000100m³=−.100L;final.049900m³.

Relative decrease.002=.2%,2% નહિ. Modulus illustrative given data છે,universal value નહિ.

body.en:
For simple Newtonian shear,tau=mu(du/dy). Dynamic viscosity mu has unit Pa·s=N·s/m². The gradient du/dy is the rate of velocity change across the fluid layer,unit s⁻¹—not the acceleration of one particle.

Kinematic viscosity nu=mu/rho has unit m²/s. For many liquids viscosity falls as temperature rises;gas viscosity commonly rises with temperature. These trends do not justify ignoring state or using one oil value for all grades.1poise=.1Pa·s;1stokes=1e−4m²/s.
body.gu:
Newtonian shear માટે tau=mu(du/dy). mu Pa·s=N·s/m²;du/dy s⁻¹ velocity gradient છે,particle acceleration નહિ.

nu=mu/rho m²/s. ઘણી liquidsમાં temperature વધતાં viscosity ઘટે;gasesમાં સામાન્ય રીતે વધે. Grade/state જરૂરી.1poise=.1Pa·s;1stokes=1e−4m²/s.

body.en:
A stationary plate and a parallel moving plate are2mm apart. Assume steady Newtonian flow,no slip and no imposed pressure gradient. Upper speedU=.50m/s,mu=.20Pa·s. du/dy=.50/.002=250s⁻¹;tau=.20×250=50Pa. On.030m² contact area,the viscous force magnitude=50×.030=1.50N.

With rho=900kg/m³,nu=.20/900=.00022222m²/s=222.22mm²/s. The fluid force resists relative plate motion;the external driving force balances it at steady speed.
body.gu:
Plate gap2mm,upperU.50m/s,mu.20Pa·s,steady/no-slip/no pressure gradient. Gradient250s⁻¹,tau50Pa;area.030m² પર force1.50N.

Rho900 માટે nu.00022222m²/s=222.22mm²/s. Viscous force relative motion oppose કરે;steady speedમાં external drive balance કરે.

body.en:
Surface tension sigma is force per unit length along an interface,unit N/m,and equivalently surface energy per area for a simple interface. It arises from molecular interactions and tends to reduce interface area. It is not a bulk pressure.

For an ideal spherical liquid droplet with one interface,excess pressure Delta p=4sigma/d. A soap bubble has two interfaces and the ideal relation is8sigma/d. Use the stated surface and model;do not apply the bubble factor to a single liquid drop.
body.gu:
Surface tension sigma interface પર force/length N/m,અને simple interfaceમાં energy/area. Molecular interaction area ઘટાડવાની tendency આપે;bulk pressure નથી.

Spherical liquid drop single interface માટે Deltap=4sigma/d;soap bubble બે interfaces માટે8sigma/d. Surface/model ઓળખો,bubble factor dropમાં નહિ.

body.en:
Adhesion,cohesion and contact angle determine the meniscus in a fine tube. For a clean circular capillary in static equilibrium,h=4sigma cos(theta)/(rho g d),where theta is measured through the liquid. Wetting contact angle below90° gives rise;above90° gives depression relative to the reservoir.

Given sigma=.072N/m,rho1000,g9.81,d1mm,theta0°,h=.288/9.81=.0293578m=29.36mm. Contact angle and tube cleanliness matter;do not assume every liquid has theta0°.
body.gu:
Fine tubeમાં adhesion/cohesion/contact angle meniscus નક્કી કરે. h=4sigma cos(theta)/(rho g d),theta liquid અંદર માપો. Below90° rise;above90° depression.

Sigma.072,rho1000,g9.81,d1mm,theta0° →h.0293578m=29.36mm. Cleanliness/contact angle જરૂરી;દરેક liquid માટે0° નહિ.

h.en: 1.1.10 Vapour pressure and the cavitation connection

body.en:
Vapour pressure is the equilibrium vapour pressure of a substance at a specified temperature. In a liquid system,if local ABSOLUTE pressure falls near/below its vapour pressure,vapour cavities can form. Collapse in a higher-pressure region may cause noise,vibration and damage.

A negative gauge reading is not automatically boiling:compare absolute pressure with vapour pressure at the actual temperature. Vapour pressure generally rises strongly with temperature. Cavitation details in pumps/turbines belong to Unit4;here the pressure-reference distinction is essential.
body.gu:
Vapour pressure specified temperature પર equilibrium vapour pressure. Local ABSOLUTE pressure vapour pressure નજીક/નીચે જાય તો cavities;higher-pressure regionમાં collapseથી noise/damage.

Negative gauge એટલે automatically boiling નહિ;actual temperature પર absolute અને vapour pressure compare. Pump/turbine details Unit4માં આવશે.

body.en:
Pressure is normal compressive force per area,p=Fn/A,unit Pa. A fluid at rest has no shear stress;at a point its pressure is the same in all directions. Pressure acts normally to a surface,not always vertically.

Take a small stationary vertical prism:bottom force pA minus top force(p+dp)A minus weight rho g A dz=0,with z upward. Hence dp/dz=−rho g. For constant density,p=p0+rho g h below a surface pressurep0. Pressure is direction-independent at one point but increases with depth.
body.gu:
p=Fn/A Pa;static fluidમાં shear નહિ અને point પર દરેક direction pressure same. Surface પર normal acts,હંમેશાં vertical નહિ.

Vertical small prism equilibrium:pA−(p+dp)A−rho g A dz=0, z upward. એટલે dp/dz=−rho g;constant rho માટે p=p0+rho g h. Point isotropy અને depth variation અલગ વાત છે.

h.en: 1.2.2 Pressure head and a hydrostatic example

body.en:
Pressure head is p/(rho g),a length of the specified fluid. Always state whether p is gauge,absolute or a difference. Head in metres of water is not the same numerical head in metres of mercury/oil for the same pressure.

At3m below an open water surface,assume rho1000,g9.81:pgauge=29430Pa=29.43kPa. A pressure of19.62kPa corresponds to2.00m water head or2.50m of oil with rho800. Atmospheric pressure cancels only when the chosen gauge reference is local atmosphere.
body.gu:
Head=p/(rho g),specified fluidની length. Gauge/absolute/difference સ્પષ્ટ. Same pressure માટે water/mercury/oil head numerical same નથી.

Open waterમાં3m depth →pgauge29.43kPa.19.62kPa →water2m અથવા rho800 oil2.5m. Gauge atmosphere reference હોય ત્યારે જ atmospheric term cancel.

h.en: 1.2.3 Pascal's law: statement and wedge derivation
h.gu: 1.2.3 Pascal Law: Statement અને Wedge Derivation

body.en:
Statement:a pressure increment imposed on a confined static fluid is transmitted throughout it and to the containing walls. Existing hydrostatic height differences remain;the law does not say every elevation has the same total pressure.

Derivation of point isotropy:take an infinitesimal wedge with alpha the inclined-face angle to horizontal and inclined area An and projected areas Ax=An sin(alpha),Az=An cos(alpha). Neglect its weight in the point limit because volume scales as length³ while pressure forces scale as length². Horizontal equilibrium:px Ax=pn An sin(alpha) gives px=pn. Vertical equilibrium:pz Az=pn An cos(alpha) gives pz=pn. The third direction is analogous.

Transmission:hydrostatic balance between two points gives p2−p1=rho g(z1−z2). After adding an imposed increment with unchanged density/geometry,subtract the two balances:Delta p2=Delta p1.
body.gu:
Statement:confined static fluid પર આપેલો pressure increment fluid/walls સુધી transmit થાય. Existing height differences રહે;દરેક level પર total pressure same એવું નહિ.

Infinitesimal wedge માં alpha inclined-faceનો horizontal સાથે angle;An inclined area,Ax=An sin(alpha),Az=An cos(alpha). Point limitમાં weight length³ અને pressure force length² હોવાથી weight negligible. Horizontal:pxAx=pnAnsin(alpha)→px=pn;vertical:pzAz=pnAncos(alpha)→pz=pn. Third direction પણ same.

p2−p1=rho g(z1−z2). Unchanged density/geometry સાથે pressure increment પછી બંને balances subtract કરીએ તો Delta p2=Delta p1.

h.en: 1.2.4 Hydraulic jack: application of Pascal law

body.en:
Equal-level piston pressures ideally match;unequal areas give force multiplication,not free energy.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A small piston of areaA1 receives the effort.
  2. A larger piston of areaA2 supports the output load.
  3. A closed compatible liquid connects the cylinders.
  4. Rigid cylinders/body withstand the rated pressure.
  5. Seals limit leakage and maintain pressure separation.
  6. Practical jacks use check/release valves and a reservoir according to design.
  7. A stable base,load seat and rated safeguards prevent uncontrolled movement.

Working — 7 steps

  1. An authorised setup supports a load within the jack rating.
  2. Effort on the small piston creates pressure increment F1/A1.
  3. The confined liquid transmits that increment to the larger piston.
  4. Output force ideally becomes F2=F1 A2/A1 at equal elevation.
  5. Volume continuity gives A1s1=A2s2 for the ideal displacement.
  6. Practical valves retain/release load only by their designed operation.
  7. Use mechanical load support as required;never work beneath a load supported only by an unsuitable lifting jack.

Uses,limitations and care

Example:A1=5cm²,A2=200cm²,F1=100N gives idealF2=4000N. If s1=80mm,s2=2mm. Friction/leakage reduce real performance. A jack is a lifting device,not automatically a safe long-term support.
body.gu:
Equal-level piston pressure ideally same;unequal areas force multiplication આપે,free energy નહિ.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Small piston areaA1 effort લે.
  2. Larger areaA2 load support કરે.
  3. Closed compatible liquid cylinders જોડે.
  4. Rigid body rated pressure withstand કરે.
  5. Seals leakage/pressure separation manage કરે.
  6. Practical check/release valves/reservoir design મુજબ.
  7. Stable base/seat/rated safeguards movement control કરે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Authorised setup rated load support કરે.
  2. Small piston effortથી F1/A1 increment.
  3. Liquid large piston સુધી increment આપે.
  4. Equal levelમાં ideally F2=F1A2/A1.
  5. Ideal volume continuity A1s1=A2s2.
  6. Practical valves designed operationથી retain/release.
  7. Required mechanical support લો;unsuitable jack-only load નીચે કામ નહિ.

Uses,limitations અને Care

A1=5cm²,A2=200cm²,F1=100N→ideal4000N;s1=80mm→s2=2mm. Friction/leakage real performance ઘટાડે. Jack automatically long-term support નથી.

body.en:
Absolute pressure is measured from absolute vacuum. Gauge pressure is pabs−patm and can be positive or negative. A positive vacuum reading usually means patm−pabs;it is the magnitude of a pressure below atmosphere,not negative absolute pressure. Atmospheric pressure varies with location/weather;use the given value.

Example given patm101.325kPa and gauge250kPa:pabs351.325kPa. Given vacuum30kPa:pabs71.325kPa,pgauge−30kPa. Always compare like references in cavitation/manometer problems.1bar=100kPa;do not silently replace given atmospheric pressure by1bar.
body.gu:
Absolute vacuumથી reference;gauge=pabs−patm positive/negative. Positive vacuum reading=patm−pabs,negative absolute નહિ. Atmospheric pressure varies;given value લો.

Patm101.325,gauge250kPa→pabs351.325kPa. Vacuum30→pabs71.325,pgauge−30kPa.1bar100kPa;given atmosphereને silently1bar નહિ.

title.en: 1.3 Total pressure and centre of pressure—no derivation
title.gu: 1.3 Total Pressure અને Centre of Pressure—Derivation વગર

h.en: 1.3.1 Resultant force on a vertical immersed area
h.gu: 1.3.1 Vertical Immersed Area પર Resultant Force

body.en:
For a plane vertical area in a static constant-density liquid with equal atmospheric reference on the other side,F=rho g A hbar,where hbar is vertical centroid depth below the free surface. Centre of pressure is the location of the resultant,not simply the geometric centre.

For this vertical case,hCP=hbar+IG/(A hbar),where IG is the second moment of area about the horizontal centroidal axis. The centre is below the centroid because pressure increases downward. This syllabus asks the concept/formula without derivation. Different external pressures or inclined/curved surfaces require the appropriate model.
body.gu:
Static constant-density liquidની vertical area અને બીજી side equal atmospheric reference માટે F=rho g A hbar. hbar centroid depth;CP resultantનું location,geometric centre નહિ.

Vertical માટે hCP=hbar+IG/(Ahbar),IG horizontal centroidal axisનું second moment. Downward pressure વધે એટલે CP નીચે. Syllabus મુજબ derivation નહિ. Other external pressure/inclination/curve માટે appropriate model.

body.en:
A vertical rectangular plate2m wide and1m high has its top1m below an open water surface;the other face is atmospheric. A=2m²,hbar=1.5m,IG=bH³/12=2/12=.166667m⁴.

F=1000×9.81×2×1.5=29430N=29.43kN. hCP=1.5+.166667/(2×1.5)=1.55556m below the free surface,or.55556m below the plate top. Do not use the full depth coordinate as the rectangle height in IG.
body.gu:
Plate width2m,height1m,top free surfaceથી1m,other face atmospheric. A2m²,hbar1.5m,IG=2×1³/12=.166667m⁴.

F29.43kN;hCP1.55556m surface નીચે,plate topથી.55556m. IGમાં plate height1m લો,total depth નહિ.

title.en: 1.4 Pressure devices: detailed construction and working
title.gu: 1.4 Pressure Devices: Detailed Construction અને Working

body.en:
A vertical open tube balances positive liquid gauge pressure with a column of the same liquid.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A flush pressure tap communicates with the liquid pipe/vessel.
  2. A transparent vertical tube provides a visible column.
  3. The tube bore must limit capillary-reading error.
  4. The open upper end establishes atmospheric reference.
  5. A graduated scale measures vertical height from the tap datum.
  6. A rigid mount keeps the tube vertical and readable.
  7. A suitable isolation/connection arrangement and containment suit the liquid.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Identify the liquid,density and gauge-pressure reference.
  2. Use the approved isolated connection with the tube correctly supported.
  3. At static equilibrium,the liquid rises under pipe pressure.
  4. The atmospheric free surface fixes pressure at the top.
  5. Read vertical meniscus height h above the specified tap datum.
  6. Calculate pgauge=rho g h using consistent units.
  7. Release/isolate safely and report capillary/oscillation/readout limitations.

Uses,limitations and care

Simple inexpensive liquid-head indication. Unsuitable for gas pressure,negative gauge pressure or impractically tall high-pressure columns;not a universal instrument.
body.gu:
Vertical open tube same liquid columnથી positive gauge pressure balance કરે.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Flush tap pipe/vessel liquid સાથે જોડાય.
  2. Transparent vertical tube column બતાવે.
  3. Bore capillary error limit કરે.
  4. Open top atmospheric reference આપે.
  5. Scale tap datumથી vertical height માપે.
  6. Rigid mount vertical/readable રાખે.
  7. Suitable isolation/connection/containment liquid મુજબ.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Liquid,density,gauge reference ઓળખો.
  2. Approved isolated connection/support લો.
  3. Static equilibriumમાં pressureથી liquid rises.
  4. Atmospheric surface top pressure fix કરે.
  5. Tap datumથી meniscus vertical h વાંચો.
  6. Consistent unitsથી rho g h ગણો.
  7. Safely isolate અને capillary/oscillation limits report.

Uses,limitations અને Care

Simple/cheap liquid-head indication. Gas,vacuum અથવા tall high-pressure columns માટે unsuitable.

body.en:
A manometer-liquid level difference balances the applied-to-atmospheric pressure difference,including any connected-liquid column.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A transparent U-tube has two communicating limbs and a lower bend.
  2. A suitable manometer liquid has known density and compatibility.
  3. One limb connects to the pressure tap through a compatible line.
  4. The other limb is open to atmosphere in this arrangement.
  5. A scale/datum measures vertical interface elevations,not curved tube length.
  6. If pipe and manometer liquids differ,the interface must remain identifiable and stable.
  7. Mount,isolating fittings and spill containment suit the rated pressure/fluid.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Identify pressure reference,each liquid density and tap elevation.
  2. Inspect the supported instrument by approved isolated checks.
  3. At static balance,the higher pressure depresses the connected heavy-liquid interface.
  4. Mark every free surface and interface height relative to a datum.
  5. Walk from a known pressure:down adds rho g depth,up subtracts.
  6. Equate pressure at connected same-liquid horizontal levels and solve the unknown.
  7. Report gauge/absolute units and isolate without unsafe fluid handling.

Uses,limitations and care

Useful for laboratory pressure/vacuum when liquid/arrangement is suitable. Trapped air,capillarity,oscillation,temperature and reading error affect results. Mercury handling requires dedicated controls;students must not improvise filling.
body.gu:
Applied-atmosphere difference liquid-level balanceથી મળે;connected-liquid head પણ ગણવો.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Transparent U બે limbs/lower bend ધરાવે.
  2. Known-density compatible manometer liquid જરૂરી.
  3. એક limb compatible lineથી tap જોડે.
  4. બીજો limb atmosphereમાં open.
  5. Scale vertical elevations માપે,curved length નહિ.
  6. Different liquidsનું interface clear/stable હોવું જોઈએ.
  7. Mount,isolation,containment rated fluid/pressure મુજબ.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Reference,densities,tap elevation ઓળખો.
  2. Supported instrument isolated checksથી inspect.
  3. Higher pressure connected heavy interface depress કરે.
  4. Free surfaces/interfaces datumથી mark.
  5. Known pressureથી down add,up subtract.
  6. Connected same-liquid horizontal levels equate/solve.
  7. Gauge/absolute units report;safely isolate.

Uses,limitations અને Care

Lab pressure/vacuum માટે suitable arrangement. Trapped air,capillarity,oscillation,temp,reading errors. Mercury માટે dedicated controls;improvised filling નહિ.

body.en:
Both limbs connect to pressure points;the instrument gives their pressure difference,not either absolute pressure alone.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A U-tube forms the communicating lower manometer path.
  2. A heavy compatible manometer liquid occupies the bend and lower limbs.
  3. The A-side connection contains the known process-fluid column.
  4. The B-side connection contains its process fluid and known elevation.
  5. Two visible interfaces distinguish process and manometer liquids.
  6. A vertical scale/datum resolves interface and tap height differences.
  7. Rated mounting,isolation and any equalising provision follow instrument design.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Label A,B,all densities and vertical tap elevations.
  2. Verify filled/vented condition by the authorised procedure,not by guessing from the level alone.
  3. Allow static hydrostatic balance without flow through the measuring limbs.
  4. Read the signed interface separation h and identify which side is higher.
  5. Write pressure changes down/up through each fluid in sequence.
  6. For equal-height water taps and heavy liquid,use pA−pB=(rho_m−rho_w)g h for the shown orientation.
  7. For unequal taps,retain the process-fluid elevation term and report the correct sign.

Uses,limitations and care

Flow-meter pressure differences and pipe-loss tests. Sensitivity falls with very dense manometer liquid for a small difference;do not use rho_m g h alone when process-liquid density matters.
body.gu:
બંને limbs pressure pointsથી જોડાય;difference મળે,એકનું absolute pressure એકલું નહિ.

Construction — 7 points

  1. U-tube lower communicating path આપે.
  2. Heavy compatible liquid bend/lower limbsમાં.
  3. A connectionમાં known process fluid.
  4. B connection fluid/elevation known.
  5. બે visible interfaces liquids અલગ બતાવે.
  6. Scale/datum interface/tap differences આપે.
  7. Rated mount/isolation/equalising design મુજબ.

Working — 7 steps

  1. A,B,densities,elevations label.
  2. Authorised filled/vented verification;level પરથી guess નહિ.
  3. Measuring limbsમાં through-flow વગર static balance.
  4. Signed h/which side higher વાંચો.
  5. દરેક fluidમાં down/up sequential pressure લખો.
  6. Equal taps/shown orientation માટે (rho_m−rho_w)g h.
  7. Unequal tapsમાં process-fluid elevation term/sign રાખો.

Uses,limitations અને Care

Flow-meter differences/pipe-loss tests. Very dense liquid small difference માટે sensitivity ઓછી;(rho_m g h) એકલું process density ignore કરે.

body.en:
A lighter manometer fluid sits above heavier process liquid,improving sensitivity for small liquid-pressure differences.

Construction — 7 points

  1. An inverted transparent U-tube has an upper communicating bend.
  2. A light compatible manometer fluid occupies the upper region.
  3. Heavier process liquid enters both lower limbs.
  4. Pressure points A and B connect at known elevations.
  5. Clearly visible stable interfaces separate the fluids.
  6. A vertical datum/scale measures their level difference.
  7. Sealing,isolation and supported fittings maintain the intended trapped-fluid configuration.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Confirm heavier/light densities and the intended pressure connections.
  2. Check the sealed configuration under the approved apparatus procedure.
  3. Allow interface positions to reach static equilibrium.
  4. Read signed interface elevations without confusing the upper bend with the measuring height.
  5. Use down/up pressure balance through the light upper liquid and process legs.
  6. For the shown equal-height water taps,pA−pB=(rho_w−rho_oil)g h.
  7. Include elevation corrections for other arrangements and isolate safely.

Uses,limitations and care

Useful for small differences when a stable compatible light liquid can be retained. Density contrast,air dissolution,leaks and interface stability limit accuracy. The sign reverses if the interface orientation reverses.
body.gu:
Lighter fluid heavier process ઉપર રહે;small differencesની sensitivity સુધરે.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Inverted tube upper communicating bend ધરાવે.
  2. Light compatible fluid upper regionમાં.
  3. Heavier process liquid બંને lower limbsમાં.
  4. A/B known elevations પર જોડાય.
  5. Clear/stable interfaces fluids અલગ બતાવે.
  6. Vertical datum/scale level difference માપે.
  7. Sealing/isolation/support intended configuration રાખે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Heavy/light densities/connections verify.
  2. Approved procedureથી sealed configuration check.
  3. Interfaces static equilibrium સુધી આવવા દો.
  4. Signed levels વાંચો;upper bend height નહિ.
  5. Light/process legsમાં down/up balance.
  6. Shown equal taps માટે (rho_w−rho_oil)g h.
  7. Other arrangementsમાં elevation correction/safe isolation.

Uses,limitations અને Care

Stable compatible light fluid સાથે small differences. Density contrast,air dissolution,leaks,interface limits. Orientation reverse તો sign reverse.

body.en:
Inclining a small tube produces a longer scale displacement for a small vertical pressure head.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A relatively large-area well receives the applied gas pressure.
  2. A narrow transparent tube rises at a known inclination theta.
  3. A compatible manometer liquid joins well and inclined limb.
  4. The open end establishes atmospheric reference in this model.
  5. An along-tube scale measures displacement L,not vertical h directly.
  6. A levelling/inclination adjustment establishes the calibrated geometry.
  7. A rigid support,zero reference and isolation protect the reading configuration.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Identify liquid density,angle and the instrument zero/reference.
  2. Level/setup the supported instrument by its approved calibration procedure.
  3. Applied pressure displaces liquid along the inclined tube.
  4. Read displacement L after oscillations settle,without parallax.
  5. For negligible well-level movement,vertical rise is h=L sin(theta).
  6. Calculate p≈rho g L sin(theta);finite well-area correction must follow its actual calibration.
  7. Record sensitivity/angle/reference and return to a safe isolated state.

Uses,limitations and care

Low gas/draft pressure indication. Small angle increases scale travel but does not eliminate capillarity,vibration,temperature or zero errors;the approximation needs a large well or calibrated correction.
body.gu:
Inclined tube small vertical head માટે longer scale displacement આપે.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Large-area well applied gas pressure લે.
  2. Narrow transparent tube known theta પર.
  3. Compatible liquid well/limb જોડે.
  4. Open end atmospheric reference આપે.
  5. Along-tube scale L આપે,direct vertical h નહિ.
  6. Levelling/inclination calibrated geometry આપે.
  7. Rigid support/zero/isolation configuration રાખે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Density,angle,zero ઓળખો.
  2. Approved calibration મુજબ level/setup.
  3. Applied pressure liquid inclined tubeમાં move કરે.
  4. Settle પછી parallax વગર L વાંચો.
  5. Well movement negligible હોય તો h=Lsin(theta).
  6. p≈rho g Lsin(theta);finite-well calibration correction જરૂરી.
  7. Sensitivity/angle/reference report અને safely isolate.

Uses,limitations અને Care

Low gas/draft pressure માટે. Small angle travel વધારે પણ capillary,vibration,temp,zero errors રહે;large well/calibrated correction જરૂરી.

body.en:
Pressure changes the shape of an oval-section curved elastic tube;linkage amplifies free-end displacement to a pointer.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A pressure socket fixes one tube end and connects to the measured system.
  2. A C-shaped elastic tube has a flattened/oval cross-section.
  3. The other end is sealed and free to move within its elastic range.
  4. A link transmits this small tip motion to the movement.
  5. A sector gear and pinion amplify rotation.
  6. A pointer and calibrated dial display the chosen pressure reference/range.
  7. Case,safety features,process compatibility and protective mounting match the service.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Choose the correct range,reference,process compatibility and certified condition.
  2. Install using rated fittings and authorised isolation;avoid loading the gauge by its case.
  3. Applied pressure enters the fixed tube end.
  4. The oval section tends toward a rounder shape,and the curved tube tends to straighten.
  5. The sealed tip displacement moves the link and sector gear.
  6. Pinion/pointer motion indicates pressure on the calibrated dial.
  7. Check zero/hysteresis/calibration as required after safe depressurisation;never adjust live equipment.

Uses,limitations and care

Rugged common industrial indication. Pulsation,overrange,temperature,corrosion and hysteresis affect readings;gauge,absolute and compound versions require the correct reference design.
body.gu:
Pressure oval curved tubeની shape બદલે;linkage free-end displacement pointer સુધી વધારે.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Socket એક end fixed/pressure જોડે.
  2. C-shaped elastic tube oval section ધરાવે.
  3. બીજો end sealed/free elastic movement.
  4. Link small tip motion transmit કરે.
  5. Sector/pinion rotation amplify કરે.
  6. Pointer/calibrated dial reference/range બતાવે.
  7. Case/safety/compatibility/mount service મુજબ.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Correct range/reference/compatibility/condition પસંદ કરો.
  2. Rated fittings/isolation;caseથી installation load નહિ.
  3. Pressure fixed endમાં જાય.
  4. Oval rounder બને અને curve straighten tendency.
  5. Sealed tip link/sector ચલાવે.
  6. Pinion/pointer dial pressure બતાવે.
  7. Safe depressurisation પછી zero/hysteresis/calibration;live adjustment નહિ.

Uses,limitations અને Care

Common rugged industrial gauge. Pulsation,overrange,temp,corrosion,hysteresis errors;gauge/absolute/compound reference design યોગ્ય હોવી જોઈએ.

body.en:
A flexible clamped membrane deflects under a pressure difference;mechanical/electrical conversion indicates the result.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A housing forms measured and reference chambers.
  2. A thin compatible diaphragm separates these chambers.
  3. The diaphragm edge is clamped/sealed to prevent leakage.
  4. A pressure port communicates with the measured side.
  5. The reference side is vented,sealed or connected as the gauge design requires.
  6. A linkage/pickoff converts small central deflection to indication.
  7. Calibration,overload protection and materials match range/media.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Identify whether the device reads gauge,absolute or differential pressure.
  2. Confirm media compatibility,range and reference-side condition.
  3. Apply system pressure only through the rated approved connection.
  4. Difference across the diaphragm creates elastic deflection.
  5. The motion/pickoff system converts deflection to a calibrated signal/reading.
  6. Read after settling and consider temperature/hysteresis/overload effects.
  7. Isolate/depressurise before inspection or replacement.

Uses,limitations and care

Useful for low pressures and appropriate corrosive/viscous media with suitable isolation construction. Not every diaphragm is chemically compatible or overload-proof.
body.gu:
Clamped flexible membrane pressure differenceથી deflect થાય;mechanical/electrical indication મળે.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Housing measured/reference chambers બનાવે.
  2. Compatible thin diaphragm chambers અલગ રાખે.
  3. Edge clamp/seal leakage અટકાવે.
  4. Pressure port measured side જોડે.
  5. Reference vent/seal/connect design મુજબ.
  6. Link/pickoff central deflection convert કરે.
  7. Calibration/overload/materials range/media મુજબ.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Gauge/absolute/differential ઓળખો.
  2. Media/range/reference condition verify.
  3. Rated approved connectionથી pressure.
  4. Diaphragm across difference elastic deflection આપે.
  5. Pickoff deflection calibrated signalમાં ફેરવે.
  6. Settle પછી reading;temp/hysteresis/overload વિચાર.
  7. Inspection/replacement પહેલાં isolate/depressurise.

Uses,limitations અને Care

Low pressure/suitable corrosive-viscous service યોગ્ય isolation સાથે. દરેક diaphragm compatible/overload-proof નથી.

body.en:
Atmospheric pressure supports a liquid column beneath a low-pressure sealed top space.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A closed-top transparent tube contains a compatible barometric liquid.
  2. The open lower end is immersed below the reservoir free surface.
  3. A reservoir surface receives atmospheric pressure.
  4. The top space has low absolute pressure,including vapour pressure.
  5. A vertical scale measures top meniscus minus reservoir surface height.
  6. A stable protected mount limits tilt,vibration and breakage.
  7. Sealed containment and authorised handling are essential for mercury instruments.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Use a qualified commercial apparatus;do not construct/fill a mercury barometer as an unsupervised exercise.
  2. Identify liquid,density,temperature and vertical scale reference.
  3. Atmospheric pressure acts on the reservoir surface.
  4. Hydrostatic balance supports the column beneath the low-pressure top space.
  5. Read vertical separation h between the two liquid surfaces.
  6. Use patm=rho g h+ptop;the small mercury-vapour correction is often neglected when specified.
  7. Report assumptions/units and follow controlled storage/handling.

Uses,limitations and care

Atmospheric reference measurement;altitude,weather,temperature and gravity affect values. Electronic/aneroid barometers avoid an exposed liquid column but use different sensing construction.
body.gu:
Atmospheric pressure low-pressure sealed top નીચે liquid column support કરે.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Closed-top transparent tube barometric liquid રાખે.
  2. Lower open end reservoir surface નીચે immersed.
  3. Reservoir surface atmosphere pressure લે.
  4. Top space low absolute/vapour pressure ધરાવે.
  5. Scale meniscus−reservoir vertical height આપે.
  6. Stable mount tilt/vibration/breakage ઘટાડે.
  7. Mercury instrument માટે containment/authorised handling જરૂરી.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Qualified apparatus લો;unsupervised mercury filling નહિ.
  2. Liquid,density,temp,scale reference ઓળખો.
  3. Atmosphere reservoir surface પર act કરે.
  4. Low-pressure top નીચે hydrostatic column balance.
  5. બે surfaces વચ્ચે vertical h વાંચો.
  6. patm=rho g h+ptop;specified હોય તો small correction neglect.
  7. Assumptions/units report;controlled storage/handling.

Uses,limitations અને Care

Atmospheric measurement;altitude/weather/temp/g અસર કરે. Aneroid/electronic construction અલગ છે.

body.en:
1 Draw tap elevations,interfaces and free surfaces with a common vertical datum.2 Mark every fluid density and the known pressure reference.3 Move down a static fluid:add rho g times vertical drop.4 Move up:subtract rho g times vertical rise.5 At an interface pressure is continuous apart from normally neglected capillary jumps.6 Equal-height points in the SAME connected static fluid have equal pressure.7 Solve and check the sign/units.

Do not equate any two points merely because they are horizontal:they must belong to the appropriate connected fluid region. Tube length,tilt and bend radius are not hydrostatic head;vertical elevation change is.
body.gu:
1 Common datumથી taps/interfaces/surfaces દોરો.2 Fluid density/known reference લખો.3 Down static fluidમાં rho g drop ઉમેરો.4 Upમાં subtract.5 Interface pressure continuous,capillary jump normally neglected.6 SAME connected static fluidના equal-height points equal pressure.7 Solve/sign/units check.

ફક્ત horizontal હોવાથી કોઈપણ બે points equate નહિ;connected fluid region જરૂરી. Hydrostatic head vertical change છે,tube length/bend radius નહિ.

h.en: 1.5.2 Solved simple U-tube with two fluids

body.en:
Water tapA lies.20m ABOVE its water/mercury interface. The atmospheric mercury free surface is.30m ABOVE that interface. Given rho_w1000,rho_m13600,g9.81. Walk:A downward through water gives pA+1000g(.20). From the open mercury surface downward gives patm+13600g(.30).

Equate:pgauge=13600×9.81×.30−1000×9.81×.20=38062.8Pa=38.0628kPa. For patm101.325kPa,pA,abs139.3878kPa. Using only rho_m g h would overestimate because the water leg also supplies pressure.
body.gu:
Water tapA interfaceથી.20m ઉપર;open mercury surface same interfaceથી.30m ઉપર. Rho water1000,Hg13600,g9.81. Aથી down water:pA+1000g.20;openથી down mercury:patm+13600g.30.

Pgauge38.0628kPa;patm101.325 હોય તો pabs139.3878kPa. Water head subtract ન કરીએ તો overestimate થાય.

h.en: 1.5.3 Solved vacuum manometer and barometric check

body.en:
A gas pressure below atmosphere raises mercury on the gas-connected side. If gas density is negligible and vertical separationh=.150m,vacuum magnitude=13600×9.81×.150=20012.4Pa=20.0124kPa. Hence pgauge=−20.0124kPa;with patm101.325kPa,pabs=81.3126kPa.

Separately,a barometer with h=.760m,rho13600,g9.81 and neglected top pressure gives patm=101.39616kPa. It is not exactly101.325kPa with those rounded inputs. Use supplied data and assumptions consistently.
body.gu:
Gas side mercury ઊંચું હોય અને gas density negligible,h.150m:vacuum20.0124kPa;pgauge−20.0124;patm101.325થી pabs81.3126kPa.

Separate barometerh.760,rho13600,g9.81,ptop negligible→101.39616kPa. Rounded inputsથી exactly101.325 નહિ;given data consistent લો.

h.en: 1.5.4 Solved differential U-tube: equal and unequal tap levels

body.en:
For equal-height water taps and mercury interface riseh=.20m from A side to B side,pA−pB=(13600−1000)9.81(.20)=24721.2Pa=24.7212kPa. If pB,gauge=12kPa,pA,gauge=36.7212kPa.

For the same signed interface difference but B tap.50m ABOVE A,pA−pB=rho_w g(zB−zA)+(rho_m−rho_w)gh=4905+24721.2=29626.2Pa. State which side/interface is higher;using the equal-level shortcut would miss4.905kPa.
body.gu:
Equal water taps,Hg interface B side.20m higher:diff24.7212kPa. pB,gauge12 હોય તો pA36.7212kPa.

Same signed interface પણ B tap Aથી.50m higher:diff=rho_wg(zB−zA)+(rho_m−rho_w)gh=29.6262kPa. Equal-level shortcut4.905kPa miss કરે.

body.en:
Inverted U:equal-height water taps,rho_w1000,rho_oil800,A interface.25m ABOVE B. Difference=(1000−800)9.81(.25)=490.5Pa=.4905kPa. Light oil is above the water,not below it.

Inclined well:rho800,L=.200m,theta30° and negligible well-level movement. Vertical rise=.200sin30°=.100m;pgauge=800×9.81×.100=784.8Pa=.7848kPa. Treating L as vertical height would double the answer. Finite well area requires the actual calibrated correction,not this approximation.
body.gu:
Inverted:equal water taps,rho1000,oil800,A interfaceBથી.25m higher→diff490.5Pa=.4905kPa. Light oil water ઉપર.

Inclined:rho800,L.200m,theta30°,well movement negligible→vertical.100m,pgauge784.8Pa. Lને vertical માનવાથી double answer. Finite well માટે calibrated correction જરૂરી.

h.en: 1.6.1 Reading errors,device choice and honest practical records

body.en:
Choose by range,fluid compatibility,reference,accuracy,response and installation. Piezometers suit moderate liquid positive heads;U-tubes suit laboratory static differences;inclined/inverted devices resolve smaller differences;Bourdon gauges offer rugged indication;diaphragm devices can suit low pressures/media isolation. No one device is best universally.

Read at eye level,use the correct meniscus convention for the instrument,record temperature/density assumptions and wait for stable readings. Check bubbles,zero,tilt,leaks and calibration without opening live pressure equipment.

Practical report:label the actual apparatus,reference datum,fluid states,raw readings,calculation,uncertainty and observed result. Never invent measurements. No physical practical is claimed by this package.
body.gu:
Range,compatibility,reference,accuracy,response,installation મુજબ device પસંદ. Piezometer moderate positive liquid;U lab differences;inclined/inverted small differences;Bourdon rugged;diaphragm low/media isolation. Universal best નહિ.

Eye-level/correct meniscus,temp/density,stable readings. Bubbles,zero,tilt,leak,calibration safe રીતે check;live equipment ન ખોલો. Reportમાં actualapparatus,datum,raw readings,calculation,uncertainty,observed result;invent નહિ. અહીં physical practical claim નથી.
